recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not rename datatypes or change questionnaire quantity handling under FHIR-5165; future comparator changes should be made through targeted element-specific issues.
issue_request: FHIR-5165 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to address Quantity.comparator by creating a comparator-capable measured quantity plus a no-comparator quantity constraint, with Observation.value[x], Observation.component.value[x], and QuestionnaireAnswers.group.question.answer.value[x] using the comparator-capable form.
initial_application: The historical application commit 6073d8ce5f2495a586e8cac31b86479933fb0623, '#5165 - reorganize Quantity data type', implemented the decision by preserving Quantity as the comparator-capable datatype and adding SimpleQuantity as the constrained no-comparator form.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Quantity and SimpleQuantity as normative datatypes. Observation.value[x] and Observation.component.value[x] still use Quantity. Later final questionnaire issues FHIR-37468 and FHIR-41195 intentionally changed questionnaire quantity answers to SimpleQuantity, so the current QuestionnaireResponse difference from the 2015 disposition is later policy rather than an unapplied FHIR-5165 defect.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk was made because the authoritative datatype and resource source already convey the correct current rule.
